prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions generally overestimate noise-corrected outcomes, though winning tests frequently exceed expected gains.
Finish hints were helpful, winning in two out of three tests.
Choose path hints showed no clear positive effect or degraded performance across four tests.
Adoption layout changes showed no clear positive effect or degraded performance across two tests.
Home notifications showed no clear positive effect across two tests.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Post-Onboarding Control Summary Screen: Adds a dedicated summary screen detailing pet controls, hiding shortcuts, and interaction commands right before finishing. (why: Support logged 3 complaints from users unclear on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Friend Selection: Moves the sign-in step to occur immediately after choosing a pet, building attachment before asking for authentication. (why: Sign-in right after path choice creates early drop-off before users feel invested in a specific pet.)
2: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Progress Checklist Redesign: Redesigns the waiting screen layout into a checklist displaying setup milestones as pet assets download. (why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s; a checklist layout keeps users informed during long loads.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Story Value Narrative Headline Clarification: Updates the story screen headline and body text to clearly explain the desktop pet concept up front. (why: Path selection drops ~20.6% of users due to unclear early expectations of what the app provides.)
4: [finish, hint] Finish Screen Quick Control Callout Hint: Adds a hint on the finish screen displaying key shortcuts for toggling pet visibility on desktop. (why: Finish hints previously won 2 out of 3 tests, and support reports users struggling to hide or control their pet.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Safety Reassurance Hint: Adds explanatory hint copy to the sign-in screen assuring users that signing in prevents pet loss. (why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after re-signing in; explicit reassurance addresses user anxiety.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Official Seal Incentive: Adds a decorative official companion seal badge component to the adoption certificate. (why: The adoption stage takes median 89s with ~18% drop-off; an official badge adds a rewarding milestone moment.)
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Asset Time Estimate: Enables the estimated remaining time indicator component on the waiting screen during asset loading. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s; displaying time estimates sets clear patience expectations for long downloads.)
8: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Friend Selection Redesign: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a split layout with pet options on the left and live details on the right. (why: Adoption conversion is 81.9%; a split layout gives equal visibility to pet options and character details.)
